# grafana_oncall_integration (Data Source)

Looks up an integration by ID, or by any combination of `name`, `team_id` and `type`. Exactly one integration must match.

To look up the direct paging integration of a team, set `team_id` and `type = "direct_paging"`. A team has at most one.

* [HTTP API](https://grafana.com/docs/oncall/latest/oncall-api-reference/integrations/)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "grafana_oncall_integration" "example_integration" {
  id = "CEXAMPLEID123"
}

data "grafana_oncall_team" "my_team" {
  name = "my_team"
}

# The direct paging integration of a team, without its ID.
data "grafana_oncall_integration" "my_team_direct_paging" {
  team_id = data.grafana_oncall_team.my_team.id
  type    = "direct_paging"
}

data "grafana_oncall_integration" "by_name" {
  name = "My integration"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The integration ID. Conflicts with `name`, `team_id` and `type`.
- `name` (String) The integration name. When set, only the integration with this exact name matches.
- `team_id` (String) The ID of the OnCall team the integration belongs to (using the `grafana_oncall_team` datasource). When set, only integrations of this team match. Set it to `"null"` to match only integrations that do not belong to a team.
- `type` (String) The type of integration, for example `direct_paging`. When set, only integrations of this type match.

### Read-Only

- `inbound_email` (String) The inbound email for the integration. Only available for integration type `inbound_email`.
- `link` (String) The link for the integration.
